title: The Unseen / Whitestone Trading Co.
wikitext: '''''The Whitestone Trading Co.''''', commonly referred as '''''The Unseen''''' (''OOC''), is a crossfaction guild originally founded by Sera'Thenis Uldreyin ([[Sera'Thenis, The Devil]]) and with its headquarters in Stormwind City. Its aims are the enrichment of the owners and high ranks with not-so-legitimate businesses in both Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, often smuggling and trading prohibited goods, sometimes stolen.
